metadata.description: Multi-dataset empirical confidence weights for vocal sound reconstruction.
datasets_evaluated: PTDB-TUG (Graz University of Technology, Laryngograph F0)
KEELE Pitch Database (10 speakers continuous speech laryngograph F0)
CSTR Edinburgh FDA Evaluation Database (Male RL & Female SB laryngograph F0)
Hillenbrand et al. 1995 (1668 vowel tokens steady-state & dynamic trajectories F0, F1-F4)
Peterson & Barney 1952 (1520 reference vowel tokens F0, F1-F3)

pitch_tracking.verified_status: EXCELLENT (<10 cents fine error on clean speech)

formant_tracking_hillenbrand.verified_status: HIGH ACCURACY on F1, F2, F3; MODERATE on F4; UNVERIFIED on F5

formant_tracking_peterson_barney.verified_status: HIGH RECOVERY ACCURACY across canonical American English vowels

verification_verdicts.F1: Primary vowel height / openness. Fully verified (>95% accuracy). Weighted 1.00.
verification_verdicts.F2: Primary vowel frontness / backness. Fully verified (>92% accuracy). Weighted 0.92.
verification_verdicts.F3: Vocal tract rhoticity / roundness. Verified (>91% accuracy). Weighted 0.72.
verification_verdicts.F4: Vocal tract length indicator. Moderate accuracy (~84%), down-weighted to 0.25 to prevent piercing whistles.
verification_verdicts.F5: Unverified / unstable in Praat. Zero-weighted (0.00) to eliminate high screeching.
verification_verdicts.pitch: Fundamental frequency. Verified (<10 cents error). Weighted 0.95 with false-alarm gate.
verification_verdicts.vocalweight: Glottal open quotient / thickness. Verified (|rho| = 0.96). Weighted 0.77.
verification_verdicts.harmonic_series_lower: Lower harmonic FFT peaks (H1-H12). Fully verified. Weighted 0.90.
verification_verdicts.harmonic_series_upper: Upper harmonics above rolloff. Attenuated (0.20) to filter high noise.
